setBoundary: Tokyo getting-around (transit) tips using Suica and route-planning from Shinjuku/airport; anxiety-reducing guidance

items.why: User context includes getting a Suica card and needing directions within Tokyo soon (sets up the type of travel help requested).
Step-by-step Tokyo transit guidance from Shinjuku to Tsukiji using Suica, including practical tips (station transfers, crowds, belongings, Suica gate use).
User expressed nervousness about a tour and asked about using Suica to reach a meeting point—useful for anxiety-reducing transit planning tips.
Detailed guidance for getting to a tour meeting point (using Suica on trains/buses), plus preparation tips like checking details and allowing transfers/schedules.
User asked how to get from Narita Airport to Shinjuku—relevant for general Tokyo navigation from major arrival points.
Concrete airport-to-Shinjuku transit options and explicit Suica/IC-card usage steps (tap in/out, follow signage).
Additional transit guidance: approximate times/costs for Narita-to-Shinjuku options and tips for choosing among them and checking schedules.
